fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... over fixture pairs: removed op, removed field, retyped field, removed setting and a log format bump are breaking; an added op, field or setting is not
fields.statement: tools/release lists each breaking difference between HEAD and the last v* tag: a removed operation or request/response field, or a field whose type changed, in describe --json; a removed or retyped daemon setting; a changed log format version
